description: M1 rename map (ruling vz-4): every old path and the new path it moved to, bytes unchanged by the move. Read by _glv3/tools/verify_change_boundary.py and tools/verify_cross_estate_unification.py: a move with identical bytes counts as unchanged, and a read by old path at an earlier commit resolves through this map.
historicalNote: Paths a declared replacement transaction names that were deleted before the move (they never moved): the old path a replay reads at its review base, and the new-style path the transaction now names. Used only to read by old path at earlier commits; never a move.
